definitions.explanation: A small brown bird of fields and grassland that rises high into the sky while singing. A traditional sign of spring.

examples.japanese: ヒバリ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鳴|な}いている→鳴く：04388_naku⟧。
⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{畑|はたけ}→畑：00842_hatake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ヒバリ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦さえずっていた→さえずる：07364_saezuru⟧。
examples.english: Skylarks were singing over the fields in spring.

examples.japanese: ヒバリ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{鳴|な}き→鳴く：04388_naku⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦{高|たか}く→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦{舞|ま}い{上|あ}がり→舞い上がる：06043_maiagaru⟧、⟦やがて→やがて：03637_yagate⟧⟦{見|み}えなく→見える：01165_mieru⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The skylark rose high into the sky, singing, and was soon out of sight.

notes:
Usually written in katakana; the kanji spelling is {雲雀|ひばり}. In haiku it is a spring ⟦{季語|きご}→季語：09561_kigo⟧ (seasonal word).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ヒバリ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦さえずる→さえずる：07364_saezuru⟧: a skylark sings
- ヒバリ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{舞|ま}い{上|あ}がる→舞い上がる：06043_maiagaru⟧: a skylark soars up
- {揚|あ}げ{雲雀|ひばり}: a skylark rising as it sings (literary)
